reason: I run everything from my phone, Excel and WhatsApp and I don't trust software with my customers. $99 a month only makes sense if it brings me jobs, and nobody outside their own company pays for this yet.
objection: $99 a month has to bring in actual jobs, not just save me a bit of time, and I'd be one of the first guinea pigs with no proof it works for a guy like me.
would_change_my_mind: Another one-or-two-truck owner showing me it booked real jobs they would have missed, or a money-back deal where I only pay after it books jobs.
